subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

Compulsion to steal
solution:
The correct answer is '**Kleptomania**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**Kleptomania**'.
 
• It means **'a mental illness that creates a strong urge to steal that somebody cannot control'.** (एक प्रकार की मानसिक बीमारी जिसमें व्यक्ति में चोरी करने की तीव्र अनियंत्रित प्रवृत्ति होती है; चोरी करने की बीमारी; चौर्योन्माद)
 
 
• *Example: George outright suffers from **Kleptomania**, often stealing things in arm's reach just because he feels the impulse to.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Kleptomania.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Megalomania**: a mental disorder or condition in which a person has an exaggerated belief in their own power or importance. (ऐसी मनःस्थिति जिसमें व्यक्ति को अपनी शक्ति में अतिरंजित विश्वास होता है; महत्वोन्माद; अहंकारोन्माद)
 
• **Pyromania**: an obsessive desire to set fire to things. (चीजों में आग लगाने की जुनूनी इच्छा)
 
• **Nymphomania**: uncontrollable or excessive sexual desire in a woman. (एक महिला में बेकाबू या अत्यधिक यौन इच्छा)
